title: refactor(GroundTheory/HeightsAndTheta/Heights/HilbertSamuel): deduplicate resolution potential, degree, and interpolation integrals
body:
Deduplicate resolution potential, degree-integral, and interpolation-integral proofs across `HilbertSamuel` by reusing `AnResBridge.isPotential_potOf` and generalizing the `AnRes` helpers in `PBlockResolutionDegreeIntegral.lean` and `PBlockResolutionInterpIntegral.lean` so `ResolutionPotentials.lean`, `PResolutionDegree.lean`, and `PResolutionInterpIntegral.lean` call them directly via `HermLine.ofCone`.

Changed declarations:
- `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.HilbertSamuel.BlockResolutionDegreeIntegral.smooth_logRatio` and `mass_eq` (in `PBlockResolutionDegreeIntegral.lean`): generalized over arbitrary `AnRes P J D` and interpolated local potentials
- `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.HilbertSamuel.BlockResolutionDegreeIntegral.mInt_blockInterpPot_eq` renamed and generalized to `mInt_interpPot_eq` (in `PBlockResolutionDegreeIntegral.lean`)
- `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.HilbertSamuel.BlockResolutionInterpIntegral.locDens_interp`, `continuous_logRatio`, and `mInt_interp` (in `PBlockResolutionInterpIntegral.lean`): generalized over arbitrary `AnRes P J D`, `A₀ A₁ : HermLine ι`, and interpolated local potentials (with shared Bernstein step factored into `interp_integral_eq`)
- `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.HilbertSamuel.isPotential_resPot` (in `ResolutionPotentials.lean`): delegates directly to `AnResBridge.isPotential_potOf`

Removed declarations:
- `resLift_continuousOn`, `resLift_contDiffOn`, `resPot_smoothOn`, `continuous_logRatio_resPt` (in `ResolutionPotentials.lean`)
- `ResolutionDegree.mInt_congr_of_locDens`, `ResolutionDegree.smooth_logRatio_resPt`, `ResolutionDegree.mInt_resPot_eq`, `ResolutionDegree.mass_eq` (in `PResolutionDegree.lean`)
- `locDens_resPot_interp`, `mInt_resPot_interp` (in `PResolutionInterpIntegral.lean`)
